name: Burger Stop
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Burger Stop in St. Anton am Arlberg**

Discover the perfect mix of mountain charm and delicious flavors at the **Burger Stop** in **St. Anton am Arlberg**. Whether you're craving a hearty **Burger**, fresh **Salads**, or a quick **Snack**, this cozy spot offers something for every taste.

After a thrilling day on the slopes, recharge with a tasty **Burger** or a refreshing **Bier** (beer) from the local selection. The relaxed atmosphere makes it the ideal place to unwind with friends or family.

Located right in the heart of **St. Anton**, the **Burger Stop** is just a short walk from the **Pisten** (ski runs) and the lively **Dorfplatz** (village square). Stop by for a quick bite or a leisurely meal—you won’t regret it!

**Prost & Genieße!** (Cheers & Enjoy!)
